title: data for freshness.set
description: Owner sets when a task's Now/Next text counts as stale and whether the board asks the lane for a status update by itself (a rebrief.request in mode status, at most one open per task, checked hourly).

stale_h.description: Hours without a Now/Next change after which the text is stale; 0 turns the age rule off (a step changing after the text still counts).
